description: This PHP class 'EmployeeSkillDecorator' provides a decorator for the EmployeeSkill entity, adding methods to associate employees and skills by their identifiers. It uses traits and references to other entities such as Employee and Skill, facilitating manipulation of EmployeeSkill objects within the HRM system.

classes.name: EmployeeSkillDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for EmployeeSkill entity, providing methods to set employee and skill associations based on IDs.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the decorator with an EmployeeSkill object.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the Employee associated with the EmployeeSkill based on employee number.

methods.name: setSkillBySkillId
methods.description: Sets the Skill associated with the EmployeeSkill based on skill ID.
